routing.trigger_summary: Builds sales objection response playbooks with rebuttals organized by objection category, empathetic acknowledgments, and reframing techniques. Use when a user keeps hearing the same objections on sales calls, wants to train a team on handling pushback, or needs confidence dealing with price, timing, and trust concerns.
